redFirst.basis: `python3 plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py --selftest --stage cr-block` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 with 4 of 7 collected tests failing an assertion, the task's own among them (HEAD's own tests on HEAD's code failing only the unknown-stage check for `cr-block`, which the task's test files add - the stage is new at HEAD), each passing with the working tree's implementation - plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py: a pause with a filed wave member, its tree deleted and the drive resumed on a fresh clone, finds the member's work (both wave members filed, and the origin holds a carry ref for each: [0, 0] []) (house FAIL) and 3 more: SELFTEST FAILED: 3/7 cases passed; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop

outcome.technical: Carry (drive-phase.py): submit of a wave member now writes the tree's work as a commit on the tree's HEAD (scratch index, record paths left out) into refs/audit/carry/<id> and pushes it to origin (carry_work, carry_commit; say 'local only' on the did-line with no origin or a failed push, never raising). Resume: wave_step with no recorded wave and width>=2 reopens a wave over in-progress tasks whose executor return is filed and whose carry exists locally or on origin (carried_members); step_member calls restore_carry after add_tree, which fetches the ref if absent and applies its diff to a clean fresh tree only for a member whose return is filed for its current start; drop_carry removes the ref locally and on origin when the member is terminal. submit_tree's state read split out as wave_state. Module docstring section added. Test (test_drive_phase.py, stage cr-block, 7 cases titled with the tests.add clause + parenthesised detail): red first seen (carry ref missing, resumed gate red 'GATE RED check_own.py src/f1.txt', 2/4), then green 7/7 after the change; falsifier run by hand in the shared tree copy then restored from a backup (5/7 with restore_carry call replaced by pass). Full sweep: 335/335 files ok, 16568 cases (exit 0). ruff, vermin, gate-parity, test__output, test__deps green. NOT DONE: 'make the handover's unblock line follow blocked_remedy' - the handover is a hand-written file in the private repo (quality-gates-internal/plans/2026-10-14-handover-machine-move.md:33), nothing under plugins/ or tools/ generates a handover or a pause report (grep -rIi handover plugins tools finds only unrelated hand-off wording), and drive-phase.py's blocked_remedy (line ~3978 before edits) already prints start/unblock correctly for a stalled print; so no code change applies and the doc line lives outside this repo. Also NOT DONE: a separate 'pause' verb - the carry at filing makes the pause safe without one. Untested: the record-path exclusion inside carry_commit (no record diff exists in the tree at filing time in the fixture). Known limit: width 1 on the resuming machine never reopens a wave (carry is only left by wave members), said in carried_members' docstring.
outcome.descriptive: A filed wave member's work now survives losing its tree: it is carried in a pushed ref and a drive resumed on a fresh clone restores it and closes the task with its bytes.

testsAdded: plugins/audit/tests/test_drive_phase.py: a pause with a filed wave member, its tree deleted and the drive resumed on a fresh clone, finds the member's work
claims: claims: (1) the refs/audit/carry push and restore work end to end - evidence: cr-block 7/7 on a real bare origin and a fresh git clone; (2) a stale or foreign carry is not laid over a tree - evidence: restore_carry is gated on already_filed and a clean tree, but NO case exercises either refusal (unverified); (3) record-path exclusion in carry_commit is unverified by any case.
